note: NOTE: branch is basic (starter, available from level 1) or nature / elemental / spiritual. Unlocks: basic from start; nature = level 3 + 5 main-stat points; elemental = level 6 + 10; spiritual = level 8 + 15. Rebalance rationale (to be tuned): basic skills are always available and cheap, so they start weaker and scale slowly (+5%/rank, v0.1.2). Category skills start stronger (or add utility) and scale faster (nature +12%, elemental +10%, spiritual +10% — raised in v0.1.2 so training is the main power-up) so they overtake basics and stay ahead. Examples: Power Strike 140% (was 180%), Energy Blast 130% (was 160%), Backstab 250% guaranteed crit, crit already baked in (was 400%). Training costs scale by tier: basic < nature < elemental < spiritual, and within a class the stronger skill costs more (e.g. Flame Cleave > Earthbreaker). Each rank still needs materials + essence + coins; rares are milestones at 5 and 10. mp_cost is placeholder MP spent on use. damage_multiplier is a factor (1.4 = 140% of attack). v0 placeholders; may pivot after playtesting. v0.1.2-descs: `desc` is the short player-facing line; design reasoning lives in `notes` and is never shown in game. `description` is kept in sync with `desc`. v0.2.1: Warrior basic and mid skills are unlocked by discoverable questlines (B-004) at rank 1; further ranks still train at Calden. Root Lash and Dig In (B-001) unlock on level + STR and are learned at Calden. Soul Guard / Shrine questline is parked; Soul Guard keeps its late sheet gate.  v0.2.3-mp: Power Strike 5, Rage 10, Earthbreaker 10, Flame Cleave 14, Soul Guard 18 (Soul Guard stays parked).  v0.2.7: path_id + prev_skill_id define the Paths trees. A skill needs its previous skill at rank 1+ (no level gate). Warrior Path: Power Strike → Earthbreaker (→ Root Lash, Flame Cleave), Dig In, Rage.  v0.2.8: Magician Path. Energy Blast → Magic Bolt, Energy Shield → Mana Shield, Firebolt → Fire Bolt, Thorn Bind → Thorn Volley; new Chain Spark. Frost Shard, Spirit Drain and other Spirit skills are future content.
